name: Sprocket
text:
Decision: We should build a lightweight “prompt health” dashboard that flags stale, redundant, or low-value prompts in real time and lets the team archive or refresh them with one click.

Why: Right now we waste cycles arguing over prompts that no one uses or that overlap. A dashboard turns vague “we should clean up” into a clear, daily habit—everyone sees the same list, so decisions are faster and fairer. It also makes it obvious which prompts are actually driving value, so we can double down on the winners.

Trade-off: We accept a small upfront build cost and the risk that the dashboard itself becomes yet another thing to maintain. But if we don’t invest now, the mess will only grow and slow us down later.
